Slides Gallery is a WordPress plugin that replaces the built in gallery functionality with a slideshow using the very awesome Slides.js plugin by Nathan Searles (http://slidesjs.com/).   As such, it's a really simple and minimalistic plugin; simply activate, and your galleries look a bit nicer, and are a bit more interactive and fast loading. No need to flip through several HTML pages, when you can quickly brush through the entire gallery in one place.
